stories.title: NWSL playoffs scheduling snafu: Washington Spirit keep Audi Field; Gotham move to Icahn
summary: Washington to play in Saturday noon broadcast windowShift to Northwest Stadium was reportedly in playGotham move to Icahn amid ‘atrocious’ pitch conditionsThe Washington Spirit will play their NWSL semi-final at Audi Field after the club reached a deal to avoid playing a playoff game at Northwest Stadium, home of the NFL’s Washington Commanders.

Top-seeded Gotham FC, meanwhile, will play their game at the 5,000-seat Icahn Stadium on Randall’s Island in New York City because of poor pitch quality at Sports Illustrated Stadium, their usual home.The Spirit will play their semi-final against the Utah Royals on 14 November (Saturday) at noon, while Gotham FC will host the Kansas City Current on Sunday at 3pm.

summary: The three defeats were all different, Maresca said, although in all of them City had had more possession and more chances.In the 2-1 defeat at Aston Villa two weeks ago, City had 63% of the ball and had 15 chances to Villa’s eight.

stories.title: Felix Nmecha’s faith is forcing Borussia Dortmund into an uncomfortable debate | Andy Brassell
summary: Midfielder’s spectacular strikes rescued a frustrating day, only for celebrations to reignite dialogue that has followed him through his careerIt was just what they needed at just the right time.
BVB have enjoyed a largely excellent start to the season, are unbeaten and level on points with Bayern Munich at the top; Bayern lead, unsurprisingly, thanks to their superior goal difference.

It is a gap which has been widened by Dortmund being far from prolific, a facet which looked as if it might undercut their efforts to roll over their visitors on Saturday, especially in the absence of the injured centre-forward Serhou Guirassy.
